What looks like conviction can become pressure inside the venture. The company may move faster in some ways while becoming brittle in others.

It is whether the company can hold the upside of that intensity without letting the same force destabilize execution. That company question makes the chapter sharper than a personality sketch. It changes how the company has to operate.
